title: New Relic launches AI Evaluation to link AI quality with production performance
key_facts: New Relic introduced AI Evaluation, a capability within its AI Observability platform, to monitor AI response quality, identify security risks and assess business impact.
It links AI response quality to the underlying application transaction, giving developers, SREs and platform teams one view of AI behaviour, infrastructure performance and resource use.
An asynchronous LLM-as-a-judge service evaluates sampled inputs and outputs and attaches quality scores to distributed traces.
Configurable guardrails aim to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, personal-data exposure, toxicity and bias.
For retrieval-augmented generation applications it assesses faithfulness and answer relevance to separate model problems from retrieval problems.
It ties response assessments to compute and token costs so teams can compare models on quality and cost.
A Prompt Playground and reusable datasets support pre-deployment testing and A/B tests.
New Relic's Chief Product Officer Brian Emerson and IDC's Stephen Elliot are quoted.
quote_evidence: New Relic has introduced AI Evaluation, a capability within its AI Observability platform designed to help enterprises monitor AI response quality, identify security risks, and assess the business impact of AI workloads across the application lifecycle.

The platform uses an asynchronous LLM-as-a-judge service to evaluate sampled inputs and outputs, assigning quality scores to distributed traces to help engineering teams identify the source of failures.
why_it_matters_hint: Teams running AI applications get quality and safety scores in the same tool as their performance monitoring.
notes: Company launch description; no independent testing reported. Text reads like a press release.
